content.short: GGMC is a Cardano NFT project providing passive income from real-world diversified crypto mining operations.
content.description: Goofy Gophers Mining Club (GGMC) is an innovative utility-focused NFT project on Cardano that provides holders with rewards from real-world crypto mining. By staking (or 'burrowing') their 8,888 unique Gopher NFTs, community members earn a share of the revenue generated from diversified mining operations, including Bitcoin and Litecoin. The project features a DAO structure where Gophers with specific roles participate in governance decisions. GGMC bridges the gap between physical infrastructure and decentralized finance, offering a sustainable model for passive income on the blockchain.
